system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: To avoid context dilution, skills are dynamically injected into agent prompt based on task semantics.
system_prompt_style.note: agent.py builds base_system_prompt and updates per task via keyword-retrieved skills ('Default, updated per task').

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: the agent prioritizes inspecting data structures and distributions before committing to analyti-cal actions
env_context_strategy.note: Claude Agent SDK tools (shell, file ops); prompt includes tool descriptions, not data context.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: the agent architecture provides automatic context compaction to manage long-horizon interactions
context_compaction.note: Provided by underlying Claude Agent SDK/Claude Code; mechanism not in evidence. memory_window_turns=6 config field also exists.

observation_format.evidence_quote: the agent ingests both user-provided task specifi-cations and execution outputs from prior actions

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: SP-Mind uses CodeAct-style paradigm (Wang et al., 2024b), allowing it to generate and execute arbitrary Python scripts, run shell commands
tool_call_format.note: Default: Claude SDK native tools with prompt-driven python -c interface; --mcp exposes typed MCP tools.

tool_count.evidence_quote: Both options expose the same 19 typed tools.
tool_count.note: Count from README; built-in Claude Agent SDK/Claude Code tools may also be exposed; tools are MCP-exposed, which by rule would not count; line number not available in excerpt.

edit_primitive.note: Uses Claude Code built-in file tools; not shown in evidence.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: of typed, schema-validated tools (generated from the tool metadata in
tool_schema_source.note: Tool descriptions hand-written in spmind/tool/tool_description/; MCP server opt-in via --mcp.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: With `--mcp`, the full toolchain is exposed to the agent as a [Model Context Protocol](https://modelcontextprotocol.io) server
protocol_standardization.note: Opt-in; also standalone stdio MCP server spmind.mcp_stdio.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: SP-Mind implements a ReAct-style reasoning loop (Yao et al., 2022), iterating through cycles of (1) observation, (2) thought, and (3) execution

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: Each skill speci-fies reasoning strategy, prerequisite dependencies, recom-mended parameter heuristics, and error recovery protocols

human_in_loop.note: Default permission_mode='default' requires approval; acceptEdits/bypassPermissions selectable.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: Multi-turn conversation is maintained via session_id.

long_term_memory.note: Static expert-curated skill files retrieved by keyword.

state_persistence.note: Session id enables multi-turn within process; no resume path shown.

self_verification.evidence_quote: iterating through cycles of (1) observation, (2) thought, and (3) execution, until task completion

termination_condition.note: Paper loop runs until completion or timeout; max_steps not evidenced—retaining only as SDK-reachable is uncertain.

timeouts.note: Documented as 'Timeout for code execution in seconds'; Alg.1 TIMEDOUT loop.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: not a substitute for OS-level isolation.
execution_isolation.note: Agent runs on host via Claude Code; imaging tools run in Docker/Singularity containers.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: we intentionally use a command-level deny-list here because the imaging tools must reach the Docker/Singularity runtime

network_policy.evidence_quote: we intentionally use a command-level deny-list here because the imaging tools must reach the Docker/Singularity runtime

permission_model.note: Default requires approval; README recommends --dangerously-skip-permissions; opt-in --sandbox blocklist.

tracing.evidence_quote: `run_agent.py` runs a single prompt and logs the full trace with a timestamp

replayability.evidence_quote: `run_agent.py` runs a single prompt and logs the full trace with a timestamp

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: reproduction scripts for the three evaluation tracks in the paper

guardrails.evidence_quote: Registers a ``PreToolUse`` hook that blocks obviously destructive shell commands before they run.

target_domain.evidence_quote: the first autonomous AI agent designed to unify the spatial proteomics analysis pipeline
